notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate Pyre of the World Tree by discarding a land card.
Pyre of the World Tree triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Resolve the Pyre of the World Tree ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness and creating a Food token.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Kaldheim // Pyre of the World Tree
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Pyre of the World Tree
